items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: all of the acrobatics that Charlie Parker or Sonny Stitt or John Coltrane or any of them, I mean, might go through.

ctx.x: And you were also saying that somebody said you didn't appreciate Charlie Parker or something and you were saying that --

Well, no, the question -- I was asked the question, how do you rate Johnny Hodges and Charlie Parker, and I said, 'I appreciate everything that Charlie Parker does.' If you know anything about music or saxophone playing at all you have to realize that this man was a giant. However, for my own personal taste, I would rather listen to Johnny Hodges just play the melody and phrase it in his own way. He doesn't have to do anything else, and that would please me much more than all of the acrobatics that Charlie Parker…
How about Johnny as a person?
